Combinatie Zwolle[https://www.instagram.com/peczwolle/p/CzidzfXLqe7 Prins Hendrik Ende Desespereert Nimmer Combinatie 💚]{{citation needed|date=September 2025}} | nickname = ''Blauwvingers'' (Bluefingers) | founded = {{Start date and age|1910|6|12|df=y}} | ground = [[MAC³PARK Stadion]] | capacity = 14,000 | chairman = Frans van der Kolk | manager = Vacant | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = {{Dutch football updater|PECZwolle}} | season = {{Dutch football updater|PECZwolle2}} | position = {{Dutch football updater|PECZwolle3}} | pattern_la1 = _zwolle2526h | pattern_b1 = _zwolle2526h | pattern_ra1 = _zwolle2526h | pattern_sh1 = _zwolle2526h | pattern_so1 = _zwolle2526h | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = 0000FF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_la2 = _peczwolle2627a | pattern_b2 = _peczwolle2627a | pattern_ra2 = _peczwolle2627a | pattern_sh2 = _peczwolle2627a | pattern_so2 = _peczwolle2627al | leftarm2 = 104040 | body2 = 104040 | rightarm2 = 104040 | shorts2 = ffffff | socks2 = 104040 | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = | website = {{official URL}} }} '''Prins Hendrik Ende Desespereert Nimmer Combinatie Zwolle''', commonly known as '''PEC Zwolle''' ({{IPA|nl|ˈpɛk ˈsʋɔlə|lang}}){{efn|name=pronunciation|The name of the city of ''Zwolle,'' where the club is based, is pronounced {{IPA|nl|ˈzʋɔlə|}} in isolation.}}, is a Dutch professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Zwolle]], Netherlands. They play in the [[Eredivisie]], the top tier of [[Dutch football league system|Dutch football]]. They have played in the Eredivisie for a total of 22 seasons, reaching sixth place in 2015. They won the [[KNVB Cup]] in [[2013–14 KNVB Cup|2014]] and also reached the final in 1928, 1977 and 2015. This is the second incarnation of the club; its predecessor of the same name went bankrupt in 1990. The current club was founded immediately afterwards as '''FC Zwolle''' before renaming back to PEC Zwolle in 2012."}}
